primary_task: Produce a Scrum facilitation artifact for a team, for example a sprint planning or retrospective plan with impediment analysis and improvement actions.

requirements.name: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, WebFetch, WebSearch
requirements.evidence: "tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, WebFetch, WebSearch"
requirements.basis: Manifest tools: "read", "write", "edit", "web_fetch": "fetch a web page or unauthenticated API by URL; hosts outside the egress allow-list are refused", "web_search": "search the public web and read result snippets"

requirements.name: context-manager
requirements.evidence: "When invoked:\n1. Query context manager for team structure and agile maturity"
requirements.basis: The manifest does not name a context manager. It grants "ask_user" and "agent": "start sub-agents that work in parallel, send them messages and list them", but lacks "connectors or integrations other than the tools listed". Would need to check whether a context-manager agent is installed.

requirements.name: team metrics / backlog tracker (velocity, burndown)
requirements.evidence: "3. Analyze impediments, velocity trends, and delivery patterns"; "Velocity trends"; "Burndown charts" -- no tracker is named; data can come from files or the user.
requirements.basis: No tracker is named in the document; the manifest lacks "connectors or integrations other than the tools listed", while "read files in the working directory" and "ask_user" are available.

notes: Live facilitation of ceremonies with people is not something any tool does; I read the deliverable as written plans/analysis in the reply or files. Context manager: numbered step, hard, status unknown; reading it as an unlisted integration gives BLOCKED on other:context-manager. If the team's metrics must come from a tracker such as Jira (not named), that connector would be unavailable.
